s: We’re OneLife: a mobile medical hardware, software and data collection company and the creators of a suite of propriety, patented, medical grade monitoring and tracking technologies that will:  Be FDA approved,  Be HIPAA compliant,  Utilize an open API for easy data communication to any existing system,  Provide the user with their own, personal and comprehensive health data account, and  Be backed by an artificial intelligence technology which can make expert suggestions to users for health and lifestyle improvement, and predictions as to health issues on a global basis.

What we’re delivering  A medical grade wearable designed specifically for the health market and a specific type of user,  A mobile health kit designed to take more advanced vitals readings,  A personal health data account for each user that centralizes a user’s health records,  An application management system that can link all this technology together for a hospital, and  Artificial intelligence that will not only be the user’s personal healthcare consultant, but will be on guard to detect developing health issues on a global scale.
